evals.prompt: Install codex CLI on this iPhone Minis terminal so I can use it as an AI coding agent
evals.expected_behaviour: Runs scripts/setup.sh (aarch64 + certs + v0.130 musl binary + proxy + wrapper), then explains the curl device-auth login step instead of running codex login directly.

evals.prompt: codex keeps saying error sending request for url, curl works fine. what's wrong
evals.expected_behaviour: Explains iSH async-socket/rustls breakage, verifies the codex wrapper env (HTTPS_PROXY=127.0.0.1:8894, SSL_CERT_FILE), checks /tmp/codex-proxy/proxy.log for CONN/ERR entries rather than reinstalling.

evals.prompt: codex login keeps dying after a minute, my device code never completes
evals.expected_behaviour: Attributes death to iOS background CPU-budget kills; switches to scripts/token_poller3.sh (curl-driven device auth) and tells the user to keep the app foregrounded while entering the code.

evals.prompt: why can't I use gpt-5.6 in codex? it says requires a newer version
evals.expected_behaviour: Explains server-side min_client gating vs the iSH panic ceiling (v0.141+ unusable), confirms the proxy rewrites 0.130.0→0.151.0 (length-neutral) and transforms the models catalog; suggests -m gpt-5.6-sol.

evals.prompt: the model picker only shows old models and there's an unknown variant max error
evals.expected_behaviour: Recognizes the catalog decode failure; checks pyproxy6 logs for 'models transform' (effort filter, prefer_websockets=false) and restarts the singleton proxy if the transform stopped firing.
